HOW IT WORKS

Three beats, all on chain.
 
01 · POST
Post a photo. It becomes a coin.

Posting creates a NEAR account named after it, <name>.juno-awkorp.testnet. That account is the token, the auction and the vault.

Reading testnet…

sha256
02 · SEALED OPENING
One minute of sealed bids. One price for all.

Every bidder escrows exactly 1 NEAR and posts only a hash. After the reveal, every winner pays the same clearing price, so being first buys nothing.

Reading testnet…

03 · FLOOR
A floor you can always redeem.

20% of every curve buy and half the auction raise go into the post's vault. Any holder can burn tokens and take their share of it, at any time.

Reading testnet…

THE APP

A feed first. The market comes with it.

Scroll, like, and tap Buy. Every card reads its post's contract on NEAR testnet: the price in NEAR, who bought, how far to graduation, and the floor.

THE NEAR TECH

What runs where, plainly.
A post is an account

create_post on the factory creates <slug>.juno-awkorp.testnet and deploys the locked token code to it in one transaction. No pool, no registry: the account is the market.

Commit, reveal, settle

Bids are sha256(account, amount, max price, salt) with identical 1 NEAR escrows. Reveal is open for 60 s; a bid left hidden forfeits 1% to the creator.

Curve and floor vault

800 tokens sell on a 16-segment curve priced in yoctoNEAR integers. redeem burns tokens for up to 99% of the holder's pro-rata vault share.

NEP-141 and NEP-148

Each post coin is a whole-unit fungible token with metadata, ft_transfer and ft_transfer_call, so wallets read it like any NEAR token.

NEP-366 meta transactions

Email calls use a device-signed delegate action. The relayer checks receiver, method, gas and deposit caps and fronts the deposit. Web wallets sign and pay directly.

Accounts

Factory juno-awkorp.testnet, deployed in HvSXP6…pzxx. Charts and holder lists come from the contract's trades() and holders() views, with no indexer.

Three beats, all on chain.
 
01 · POST
Post a photo. It becomes a coin.

Posting creates a NEAR account named after it, <name>.juno-awkorp.testnet. That account is the token, the auction and the vault.

THE NEAR TECH

What runs where, plainly.
A post is an account

create_post on the factory creates <slug>.juno-awkorp.testnet and deploys the locked token code to it in one transaction. No pool, no registry: the account is the market.

Commit, reveal, settle

Bids are sha256(account, amount, max price, salt) with identical 1 NEAR escrows. Reveal is open for 60 s; a bid left hidden forfeits 1% to the creator.

Curve and floor vault

800 tokens sell on a 16-segment curve priced in yoctoNEAR integers. redeem burns tokens for up to 99% of the holder's pro-rata vault share.

NEP-141 and NEP-148

Each post coin is a whole-unit fungible token with metadata, ft_transfer and ft_transfer_call, so wallets read it like any NEAR token.

NEP-366 meta transactions

Email calls use a device-signed delegate action. The relayer checks receiver, method, gas and deposit caps and fronts the deposit. Web wallets sign and pay directly.

Accounts

Factory juno-awkorp.testnet, deployed in HvSXP6…pzxx. Charts and holder lists come from the contract's trades() and holders() views, with no indexer.
